# Objective

Fix the two defects found by the wps_1012 refalign workflow (2026-10-22) and
cut a patch release, v0.5.1.

# Steps as executed

1. Fix 1: `sum_match_del_skip_cigar` now sums M/=/X/D/N (`processing.py`);
   regression unit test + a bam-level qc-summary test with `28=`/`14=2X12=`.
2. Fix 2: `ErrorStatsOutputPaths.from_args` appends `.{ext}` verbatim
   (`stats/error_stats.py`); dotted-stem regression added, the old
   suffix-stripping test rewritten to literal semantics.
3. Suite: 153 passed (was 150); ruff check clean. The blanket
   `pixi run format` swept 11 out-of-scope files (repo not format-clean under
   the current ruff) — reverted; the five in-scope files stay formatted.
4. Real-data verification: the fixed CLI on the gs9973 sample-1 cs bam
   reports fl=668/984 (v0.5.0: fl=0) — the exact full-span count from the
   original diagnosis.
5. Release: bump 0.5.0 → 0.5.1 in pyproject.toml, pixi.toml,
   `src/sam_tagger/__init__.py`; `sam-tagger --version` verified; two fix
   commits + docs commit + release commit; annotated tag `v0.5.1` pushed
   with main; the workflow auto-creates the release; `gh release edit`
   installs curated notes (incl. the prefix behavior change).

# Verification status

1. 153 tests green, lint clean — MET.
2. fl=668 on the production bam — MET.
3. `sam-tagger --version` → 0.5.1 — MET.
4. Workflow run green with wheel + sdist attached and curated notes —
   recorded in the report.
